Calls now work with Element X, and coturn behind NAT relays on the right address.

## ✨ Added

- **Element Call for Element X.** Set `ELEMENT_CALL_LIVEKIT_SERVICE_URL` to the public URL of a LiveKit JWT service, and Synapse advertises the MatrixRTC transport, allows delayed events and gets the rate limits Element Call asks for. Element Web moves its calls to Element Call too. LiveKit and the JWT service run as two separate containers; the [setup guide](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/matrix/blob/main/docs/setup.md#element-call) has a section on them.
- **`TURN_EXTERNAL_IP` sets coturn's `external-ip`.** Behind NAT, coturn otherwise offers its private address for relaying, and calls between networks fail even with the ports forwarded.
- **`ELEMENT_EXTRA_CONFIG` merges a JSON object into Element Web's `config.json`,** for anything the template has no field for.
- **`/data/homeserver-custom.yaml` is read after the generated config files,** so you can change settings the container rewrites on every start, such as `max_upload_size`. The container stops with an error if the file is not valid YAML.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Element Web follows the browser language** instead of starting every new session in German, and shows **Forgot password?** on the sign-in page. A reset needs Synapse to be able to send email.

## Upgrade notes

- To keep German and the hidden reset link, set `ELEMENT_EXTRA_CONFIG` to `{"setting_defaults": {"language": "de_DE", "UIFeature.passwordReset": false}}`.
- The Unraid template has new fields for TURN External IP, Element Call and the two Element Web JSON settings. Element Call and the JSON settings sit under **Show more settings**.

All four features started as work by [@ezz-91](https://github.com/ezz-91) in their fork. Thank you!
